title: An ultra-Orthodox community in Israel has its own Hill
summary: Ky Dickens tells of An ultra-Orthodox community in Israel has its own Hill, about c. 2023 at Israel, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: golden and they live in an very Ultra Orthodox community in Israel they have their own Hill

plain: Documentary maker Ky Dickens, whose film is about children said to read minds, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a family named Golden living in a very strict religious Jewish community in Israel. She says that community has "its own Hill", her term for a shared place the children describe, though the telling gives no more detail. It is told to suggest the same experience shows up in very different communities.
